# DI A fixed acceptance inputs

Frozen by 小张 on 2026-11-13 before parser implementation: 20 self-authored text PDFs (25 pages), 20 self-authored DOCX files, source-based gold and 25 negative recipes. `manifest.json` records each file's SHA-256, bytes, ordered logical units and gold text. Gold is generated from source strings, never from extraction output. The acceptance corpus is immutable; a change requires a version, reason and complete rerun. Implementation must not branch on case IDs or substitute expected text. Separate development fixtures are generated by the tests; they do not change these 40 denominators.

PDF coverage: embedded NotoSansSC, standard unembedded Helvetica, mixed Chinese/English, Greek, multiple pages, wrapped lines and simple drawn tables. All 25 pages were rendered with Poppler and visually checked using the complete contact sheet plus full-size Greek/table/wrapped-line pages. Poppler independently extracted all 20 PDFs equal to source gold after the specified normalization. This checks fixture integrity only, not project parser quality. Poppler emitted generic missing Symbol/ArialUnicode display-font warnings; none of these fonts is referenced by these fixtures and the rendered content is legible, without missing characters or clipping.

DOCX coverage: titles, mixed scripts, non-BMP and combining Unicode, tabs, explicit breaks, blank paragraphs, long text and table cells containing multiple paragraphs. These are logical paragraph units in XML order, including blank units in the numbering. No Word pagination claim. Formula layout, headers/footers, footnotes and advanced drawing/reading-order reconstruction are outside this A core corpus.

Authoring: `scripts/generate-document-fixtures.py`, ReportLab 4.4.9 (BSD); runtime tests need neither ReportLab nor Word. Google NotoSansSC is SIL OFL 1.1; the embedded subset's source URL, verified Git blob and SHA-256 are in `font-sources.json`, with the full license under `licenses/`. All content is authored for this project, without student data.

The negative recipe list is frozen separately before implementation. Oversize, expanded ZIP, decompression and resource cases are generated in memory to avoid committing large hostile binaries. Controlled timeout/OOM/interruption tests invoke the actual runner/child boundary using test-owned executables; no test switches are shipped in the production CLI. Service/HTTP upload validation, persistence, retries and B/C blind evaluation remain later tasks.
